ItemID: NA; Title: Hybrid Theory; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its mix of heavy riffs and melodic hooks fits my interest in accessible hard rock.
ItemID: NA; Title: St. Anger       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The heavy sound interests me, but I would choose albums closer to my recent Tool and Disturbed listening this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fallen; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The melodic heavy sound could appeal, but I am more interested in riff-driven metal right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Sickness; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Having recently explored Ten Thousand Fists, I would try more Disturbed for the forceful vocals and rhythms.
ItemID: NA; Title: Aenima       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: My recent interest in 10.000 Days makes another Tool album with intricate rhythms especially appealing.
ItemID: NA; Title: Lateralus; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I would choose this to explore more of the layered, progressive heavy sound that drew me to Tool.
ItemID: NA; Title: Curse; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: If this is Atreyu's album, its melodic metalcore fits my heavier listening, but Tool takes priority today.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Marshall Mathers       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for guitar-driven rock and metal right now, and my recent listening gives little reason to choose rap.
ItemID: NA; Title: Get Rich Or Die Tryin'       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: This does not match the heavy bands and melodic rock I currently want to explore.
ItemID: NA; Title: Toxicity; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its intense riffs and shifting rhythms suit my interest in both aggressive metal and more intricate heavy music.
